reason: Provides a persistent interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness, retaining one agent and session across conversational coding prompts and supporting session and slash commands.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可持续交互的终端模式，在多轮提示之间保留同一智能体和会话，并支持会话管理及斜杠命令。
summaries.en: Provides a persistent interactive terminal mode for DeepSeek Harness that keeps one agent and session across prompts while supporting session management and slash commands.

capabilities: maintains a persistent interactive terminal session
reuses the host agent, session, tools, permissions, commands, and shutdown lifecycle
supports slash commands for session management and DSH features
